h1: B2B Lead Generation Company in Jaipur
intro: Looking for a lead generation company in Jaipur? Myntmore runs cold email, LinkedIn outreach and ABM for Jaipur's gem and jewellery exporters, handicraft and home textile makers, and IT services firms. We work remotely from Mumbai, campaigns go live within 18 days, and the first qualified conversations usually arrive in weeks 3 to 4.

why.title: Exporters who depend on trade fairs
why.desc: Jaipur's gemstone, jewellery and handicraft exporters meet most new buyers at a few international fairs a year. Between shows, importers and retail buyers hear from nobody unless someone reaches them directly.

why.title: Buyers who already have suppliers
why.desc: A jewellery chain in the US or a home décor importer in Europe already buys from somewhere. To earn a sample request, the first message has to show a range, finish or price point that fits what they sell, not a general catalogue.

why.title: IT firms competing with bigger cities
why.desc: Jaipur's IT and software services firms, many of them in Mahindra World City and Sitapura, sell against vendors from Bengaluru, Pune and NCR. Outreach that names a specific problem for a specific buyer is how they get past the first email.
